Gaze Spacial

Year: 2025
Client: Gaze Spacial
Sound: Kristian Mølholm

I was commissioned by GAZE Spacial to design a poster for their listening event at Empire Bio. The brief called for a design that functioned as an animation and a still image while conveying holiness and mystery, leading me to think of an abstract sculpture that embodies.

This project was a study in capturing the essence of an event through design, visually communicating the event’s atmosphere and aesthetic so the audience could grasp mood and experience through poster.
